question: What average porosity and initial reservoir pressure does the reservoir model of the CO2-WAG stacking-learning optimization have?
rendered: The reservoir model of the CO2-WAG stacking-learning optimization has an average porosity of 17% and an initial reservoir pressure of 13910 psi.
